## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Vasthraalayam Tailoring?
Shop #13, First Floor, Corporation Shopping Complex, Velachery – Tambaram Main Road, Kamarajapuram (near bus stop), Sembakkam, Chennai 600 073.

### What facilities does Vasthraalayam Tailoring have?
Bridal designer blouses, Bridal lehengas, Wedding theme costumes, Designer & pattern blouses, Katori, prince-cut & cutwork, Salwar suits, Western tops & skirts, Kids' tailoring, Men's formal shirts & pants, Hand, machine & computerised embroidery, Computerised laser cutting, Pay online.

### Do you stitch for men and kids too?
Yes. Women's, men's and kids' tailoring: from bridal blouses and lehengas to boys' trousers and men's formal shirts and pants.

### Can I bring my own design?
Yes. We tailor to your standard size, to your own creative design, or a mix of your idea with existing models and patterns.

### How do I book an appointment at Vasthraalayam Tailoring?
Pick a date in the appointment section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 95515 72827.
